comments.en_US: Listens to BlueZ org.bluez.Battery1 signals (GDBus) for the paired Px7 S2e headphone. Zero polling: the key updates only when BlueZ reports a new battery percentage. The last known value is stored in the action settings, so it stays visible while the headphones are powered off.

Trademarks: Bluetooth is a trademark of Bluetooth SIG, Inc. Px7 S2e is a trademark of Bowers & Wilkins. This is an unofficial, personal plugin and is not affiliated with either.
